prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right entered at speed and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt my head snap to the left before my body was thrown against the seatbelt. I have described the collision the same way to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff who saw me afterward. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be processed. Since the crash I have had stiffness and sharp pain in my neck and a constant ache across my lower back. I have been told these are neck and back strains, and I am following the treatment plan my doctor gave me.
